operations.description: Deletes the settings associated with a project, folder, or organization. This will have the effect of disabling Access Approval for the project, folder, or organization, but only if all ancestors also have Access Approval disabled. If Access Approval is enabled at a higher level of the hierarchy, then Access Approval will still be enabled at this level as the settings are inherited.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] accessapproval projects delete access approval settings [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets an approval request. Returns NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss info locations properties reason request resource signature

operations.description: Lists approval requests associated with a project, folder, or organization. Approval requests can be filtered by state (pending, active, dismissed). The order is reverse chronological.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests list [PATH] approval requests [PARAMS] access alt callback fields filter key oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss list locations properties reason request requests resource response

operations.description: Updates the settings associated with a project, folder, or organization. Settings to update are determined by the value of field_mask.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] accessapproval projects update access approval settings [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key mask name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type update upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval enrolled service settings

operations.description: Approves a request and returns the updated ApprovalRequest. Returns NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist. Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION if the request exists but is not in a pending state.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests approve [PATH] name approve [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss info locations message properties reason request resource signature

operations.description: Dismisses a request. Returns the updated ApprovalRequest. NOTE: This does not deny access to the resource if another request has been made and approved. It is equivalent in effect to ignoring the request altogether. Returns NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist. Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION if the request exists but is not in a pending state.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests dismiss [PATH] name dismiss [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss info locations message properties reason request resource signature

operations.description: Invalidates an existing ApprovalRequest. Returns the updated ApprovalRequest. NOTE: This does not deny access to the resource if another request has been made and approved. It only invalidates a single approval. Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION if the request exists but is not in an approved state.
